ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped blobs (5-20 pixels in diameter) across both dark lobes, with higher densities concentrated toward the distal tips and the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~0.12 relative to the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency micro-serrations and a significant macro-scale notch/indentation on the left lobe at approximately 35% width from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep from the central notch to the lateral tips; visible lower boundaries show a broad convex curve prior to water-surface occlusion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense field of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the entire visible surface of both lobes, particularly dense on the distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned horizontal light-colored linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy, high-contrast rugose white encrustations at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
